raw_request: 确认Luna配置后开启三个长期辅助session并发开发，主任务负责主开发、审核与合并
understood_objective: Establish shared service contracts, then implement isolated relay, provider/OpenCode and Agent Work modules with three Luna sessions; the primary task owns daemon/network integration, validation and merge.
acceptance_criteria: Shared contracts have one owner before parallel implementation; no duplicate configuration, routing or resource truth.
Three Luna sessions implement server, config/OpenCode and agent paths in separate clean worktrees; primary task owns shared interfaces and integration.
Each candidate passes affected tests, typecheck/build, applicable public-entrypoint validation and review before integration.
Service deployment operations and cross-device evidence are bound before service delivery; type declarations do not prove runtime implementation.
Preserve main and peer worktrees; integrate reviewed candidates through explicit Git evidence.
non_goals: Claim runtime readiness from type declarations or unit tests.
Publish to production without deployment authorization.
Reuse the retired host UI as the new Console.
Modify upstream providers or disclose credentials.
assumptions: One source admission unit contains existing code; semantic ownership stays in docs/architecture/module-registry.json.
Console is optional; passive capability Agents and one-to-many work are first-class.
First release includes public network, NAT and relay; live runtime gates remain pending.
